searchText: In a mature ETH 2.0 world won't compounding of interest anyway happen? As in ... is the plan really to block the withdrawal (and subsequent restaking) of returns permanently? Compounding of returns is a problem inherent to proof of stake itself, the only consolation is that it will only happen by a few percentage points 1) when withdrawals are allowed surely compounding will happen. I am just saying that it's incredibly unfair to small stakers to allow excess transfer (and therefore compounding) before withdrawals are allowed. 2) an exponential is much larger than a linear function no matter how small the exponent "incredibly unfair" might have to be quantified and balanced against the benefit of the proposal i guess
